bugs.title: SwitchMLP router torch.nn.Linear init not wrapped in data-parallel RNG tracker
bugs.root_cause: Buggy init does `self.router = torch.nn.Linear(...)` outside of any RNG tracker fork. If the default CUDA RNG state is asymmetric across TP ranks at the point of router construction, weights diverge. Fix wraps init in `get_cuda_rng_tracker().fork(get_data_parallel_rng_tracker_name())`.
bugs.invariant: During SwitchMLP construction, the router's weight init must execute inside a get_cuda_rng_tracker().fork(<data-parallel name>) context

bugs.title: ZeRO-2 + CPU offload micro_step_id off-by-one and wrong copy/accumulate gating
bugs.root_cause: DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer initialised micro_step_id=0 (instead of -1). After backward()'s `+= 1`, the first global step sees ids (1..gas) while subsequent steps see (0..gas-1). The copy/accumulate gating used `not is_gradient_accumulation_boundary` for copy, which copies on every non-boundary microstep instead of only the first.
bugs.invariant: On every global step, micro_step_id sequence must start at 0 (so first call has id == 0)

bugs.title: clip_grad_norm_ uses torch.max instead of torch.min for clip_coef
bugs.root_cause: deepspeed/runtime/utils.py:clip_grad_norm_ used torch.max(1, max_norm/total_norm) so clip_coef=1 when grads exceed threshold (no clipping). Fix changes max -> min so clip_coef<=1 properly clips.
bugs.invariant: After clip_grad_norm_, ||grad|| must be <= max_norm (within tolerance)

bugs.title: AdamWConfig.build does not set initial_lr on param_groups; restart-time peak LR lost
bugs.root_cause: build() returned torch.optim.AdamW without setting initial_lr. PyTorch LRScheduler with last_epoch>=0 requires initial_lr in each param_group; without it, peak LR after restart is lost.
bugs.invariant: after AdamWConfig.build(model), every param_group must contain key 'initial_lr'
trigger_conditions: Restart / scheduler that depends on param_groups[*]['initial_lr']

bugs.title: OLMoSequentialBlock attn_norm overwrites residual stream
bugs.root_cause: OLMoSequentialBlock.forward did `x = self.attn_norm(x)` clobbering residual stream so identity path uses normed x.
bugs.invariant: After calling self.attn_norm, the residual variable x must equal original input, not the normed version

bugs.title: cross_entropy_loss z-loss reduction='mean' uses wrong masked-mean formula
bugs.root_cause: buggy: z_squared = z_squared / (labels != ignore).mean() returns vector divided by scalar, wrong scaling. Fix: z_squared = (z_squared * (labels != ignore)).mean() returns scalar masked-mean.
bugs.invariant: olmo.train.cross_entropy_loss z_loss with reduction='mean' must equal 1e-4 * masked_mean(logsumexp**2 of valid tokens)

bugs.title: Trainer.train_micro_batch divides z_loss by num_micro_batches instead of batch_size_in_tokens
bugs.root_cause: z_loss = z_loss / num_micro_batches scales auxiliary loss by gradient accumulation count, not by token count. With T=batch_size_in_tokens >> num_micro_batches, z_loss dominates loss and corrupts training.
bugs.invariant: z_loss returned by train_micro_batch must equal raw_z_loss / batch_size_in_tokens (same divisor as ce_loss)

bugs.title: LinearWithFrozenWeight backward forgets to all-reduce grad_input across TP
bugs.root_cause: LinearWithFrozenWeight.backward returns grad_input without all-reducing across TP ranks. Each rank only sees its column-shard of grad. linear_with_frozen_weight took async_grad_allreduce as dummy arg.
bugs.invariant: After backward of linear_with_frozen_weight on TP=N, grad_input should equal sum across N ranks (i.e., expected = N * local_grad)

bugs.title: DeepSpeedEngine.communication_data_type defaults to fp32 when only bfloat16 is enabled
bugs.root_cause: DeepSpeedEngine.communication_data_type returned torch.float32 when bf16_enabled but no explicit comm dtype, so allreduce/reduce ran in fp32 silently breaking bf16 contract. Fix: return torch.bfloat16 when bfloat16_enabled.
bugs.invariant: engine.communication_data_type() must be torch.bfloat16 when only bf16 is enabled

bugs.title: get_data_parallel_src_rank uses global_rank % num_dp_groups instead of looking up first global rank in the DP group
bugs.root_cause: Buggy formula `global_rank % num_data_parallel_groups` only matches the true DP src rank when DP groups are contiguous global ranks; with PP > 1 or other interleavings, the formula returns the wrong rank.
bugs.invariant: get_data_parallel_src_rank() must equal min(global ranks in the local DP group)

bugs.title: DistributedDataParallel.finish_grad_sync forgets to scale expert_grads by 1/dp_world_size
bugs.root_cause: DistributedDataParallel.finish_grad_sync syncs the regular grad buffers but never divides expert_grads (local-only main_grads of MoE expert params). Buggy expert grads are dp_world_size× larger than intended.
bugs.invariant: After finish_grad_sync, expert_grad_norm_after / expert_grad_norm_before == 1 / data_parallel_world_size

bugs.title: forward_backward_pipelining_with_interleaving uses num_microbatches instead of total_num_microbatches in the param-sync gate
bugs.root_cause: Condition `param_sync_microbatch_id < num_microbatches` should be `< total_num_microbatches`; only first num_microbatches param-syncs were aligned across PP ranks.
bugs.invariant: param_sync_func should be invoked the same number of times whether the gate uses num_microbatches or total_num_microbatches when total = num*num_chunks > num

bugs.title: FlashSelfAttention.forward sets self.dropout_p=0 in eval branch and never restores
bugs.root_cause: The eval branch did `self.dropout_p = 0`, mutating the instance. After the call self.dropout_p is permanently 0 even when training resumes. Fix introduces a local `dropout_p` variable.
bugs.invariant: After running forward in eval mode, the FlashSelfAttention.dropout_p attribute must equal the constructor's attention_dropout (no permanent mutation)

bugs.title: InferenceEngine creates EP groups with num_experts instead of ep_size
bugs.root_cause: InferenceEngine.__init__ called self._create_ep_parallel_group(config.moe.moe_experts); should be (config.moe.ep_size). When num_experts > ep_size the EP group has wrong size — when num_experts > world_size, group construction fails or creates malformed groups.
bugs.invariant: InferenceEngine._create_ep_parallel_group must be called with ep_size, not num_experts
trigger_conditions: deepspeed.init_inference with a model containing deepspeed.moe.MoE

bugs.title: single_all_to_all routes uneven-head path on second all2all when divisibility fails
bugs.root_cause: Buggy gate `if get_num_kv_heads() is not None or num_heads % seq_world_size != 0` routes to uneven_heads_all2all even on the second all2all when divisibility fails. Uneven path does not produce correct output for second all2all.
bugs.invariant: On second all2all (scatter_idx<2) with divisibility failure and kv_heads None, must NOT take uneven_heads_all2all path
trigger_conditions: DeepSpeed sequence-parallel single_all_to_all with scatter_idx<2 (second all2all)
get_num_kv_heads() is None at call time

bugs.title: Gradients are summed instead of averaged when using gradient accumulation steps with pipeline parallelism
bugs.root_cause: PipelineEngine 禁用了 loss_scale_by_gas 但没有补偿性的梯度平均逻辑，导致梯度累积时梯度被求和而非平均，梯度范数与累积步数成正比
bugs.detection_method: 梯度范数与 gradient_accumulation_steps 成正比；不同 GAS 配置下相同 effective batch size 产生不同梯度范数
bugs.detection_signal: 梯度范数与 gradient_accumulation_steps 成正比；不同 GAS 配置下相同 effective batch size 产生不同梯度范数

bugs.title: Incorrect gradient computation in ZeRO-2 with DeepSpeed >= 0.17.6
bugs.root_cause: ZeRO-2 backward pass 中梯度计算存在回归 bug，导致梯度范数显著偏低（从 4.7-6.0 降到 1.6-3.2），训练质量悄然退化
bugs.detection_method: ZeRO-2 下梯度范数相比 ZeRO-1/ZeRO-3 显著偏小
bugs.detection_signal: ZeRO-2 下梯度范数相比 ZeRO-1/ZeRO-3 显著偏小

bugs.title: Cross-partition parameters incorrectly updated when using ZeRO-1/ZeRO-2 with reduce_scatter=true and Muon optimizer
bugs.root_cause: reduce_scatter 后非 target rank 保留了未 reduce 的 local 梯度，跨 partition 边界的参数梯度在不同 rank 间不一致，Muon 正交化在错误梯度上运算
bugs.detection_method: 不同 DP rank 上跨 partition 边界参数的梯度值不一致
bugs.detection_signal: 不同 DP rank 上跨 partition 边界参数的梯度值不一致

bugs.title: DistributedAttention produces numerically incorrect results when sequence length is not divisible by world size
bugs.root_cause: SeqAllToAll 在序列长度不能被 world_size 整除时产生错误的 uneven split，输出与参考实现有 max abs diff ~0.68 的偏差
bugs.detection_method: DistributedAttention 输出与本地 attention 参考实现的 max abs diff 异常大
bugs.detection_signal: DistributedAttention 输出与本地 attention 参考实现的 max abs diff 异常大

bugs.title: DeepSpeed ZeRO Stage-3 + CPU offloaded optimizer (CPUAdam) inconsistency metadata between subgroup
bugs.root_cause: CPUAdam 的 IncrementStep 在同一 step 内多次 subgroup 调用时，std::pow 路径与乘法路径产生不同的 bias_correction2 值，导致参数更新不一致
bugs.detection_method: 同一 optimizer step 内不同 subgroup 的 bias_correction2 值不同
bugs.detection_signal: 同一 optimizer step 内不同 subgroup 的 bias_correction2 值不同

bugs.title: Integer overflow in FusedAdam silently prevents weight updates for large tensors (>= 2^31 elements)
bugs.root_cause: TensorListMetadata 的 sizes 数组使用 int32，超过 2^31 个元素的 tensor 溢出为负值，CUDA kernel 循环不执行，参数和 optimizer state 不更新
bugs.detection_method: 大 tensor 的参数在 optimizer step 后 checksum 不变；权重更新量为零
bugs.detection_signal: 大 tensor 的参数在 optimizer step 后 checksum 不变；权重更新量为零

bugs.title: Missing input validation for fp16 loss_scale accepts float('inf')
bugs.root_cause: fp16 配置的 loss_scale 接受 float('inf') 而不报错，导致梯度被 inf 缩放后悄悄变成 NaN
bugs.detection_method: loss_scale 为 inf；梯度出现 NaN 但无 validation error
bugs.detection_signal: loss_scale 为 inf；梯度出现 NaN 但无 validation error

bugs.title: DeepSpeed accuracy issue for torch.compile if activation checkpoint function not compiler disabled
bugs.root_cause: DeepSpeed 自定义 checkpoint 函数与 torch.compile 不兼容，RNG state 保存/恢复机制不匹配导致 dropout 在 forward/backward 间产生不同随机数，loss 逐步发散
bugs.detection_method: loss 随训练步数缓慢发散（40000 步后 6.09 vs 期望 5.12）；启用 torch.compile 时 loss 与不启用时不同
bugs.detection_signal: loss 随训练步数缓慢发散（40000 步后 6.09 vs 期望 5.12）；启用 torch.compile 时 loss 与不启用时不同

bugs.title: ZeRO Stage 3 Overwrites Module ID Attribute Causing Incorrect Expert Placement on GPUs
bugs.root_cause: ZeRO-3 的 _register_hooks_recursively 使用通用 .id 属性覆盖用户自定义的 expert ID，导致 MoE expert 到 GPU 的映射关系被破坏
bugs.detection_method: MoE expert 的 module.id 值在 deepspeed.initialize() 后改变；expert 到 GPU 的放置逻辑错误
bugs.detection_signal: MoE expert 的 module.id 值在 deepspeed.initialize() 后改变；expert 到 GPU 的放置逻辑错误

bugs.title: Fix ZeRO-1/2 CPU-offloaded gradient loss with multiple backward() per step
bugs.root_cause: ga_steps > 1 条件阻止了 ga_steps=1 但有多次 backward 场景的梯度累积，中间 backward 的梯度被丢弃，参数偏差达 2e-3
bugs.detection_method: CPU offload 时参数值与非 offload 参考实现有 ~2x learning_rate 量级的偏差
bugs.detection_signal: CPU offload 时参数值与非 offload 参考实现有 ~2x learning_rate 量级的偏差

bugs.title: BF16_Optimizer last-microbatch grad leak under ZeRO-1
bugs.root_cause: backward_epilogue() called AFTER allreduce_gradients(). Last micro-batch FP32 grads not included in allreduce.
bugs.invariant: opt.backward_epilogue must be called BEFORE allreduce_gradients
bugs.detection_signal: 不同 DP rank 的参数 checksum 在 optimizer step 后短暂不一致；loss 曲线随 per_device_batch_size 不同而发散

bugs.title: Fix zero 1 and 2 CPU-offloaded gradient norm
bugs.root_cause: CPU offload 场景下 micro_step_id > 0 的梯度被丢弃而非累积到 CPU，导致梯度范数在首个 microstep 后冻结，严重低估真实梯度幅度
bugs.detection_method: gradient_accumulation_steps > 1 时梯度范数不随 microstep 增长
bugs.detection_signal: gradient_accumulation_steps > 1 时梯度范数不随 microstep 增长

bugs.title: Fix bf16 gradient norm divergence with ZeRO stage 0
bugs.root_cause: 两个独立 bug：(1) FP16_UnfusedOptimizer 对 bf16 tensor 使用 dynamic loss scale=65536 但 backward 时未缩放 loss，梯度被除以 65536 导致灾难性缩小；(2) 非 ZeRO bf16 模式下梯度清零被跳过，梯度无限累积
bugs.detection_method: bf16+ZeRO0 时梯度范数持续增长不归零；loss scale 与 bf16 不匹配
bugs.detection_signal: bf16+ZeRO0 时梯度范数持续增长不归零；loss scale 与 bf16 不匹配

bugs.title: Ping-pong buffer index reset causes gradient reduction data race
bugs.root_cause: self.index = 0 resets buffer index at wrong point, causing reduce_ipg_grads to use stale data
bugs.invariant: Ping-pong buffer index must not be reset between gradient reduce calls
bugs.detection_signal: 开启 overlap_comm 后梯度范数与关闭时有微小但系统性的偏差

bugs.title: Misplaced overflow return always exits FP16 optimizer step
bugs.root_cause: return self.overflow at wrong indentation causes optimizer step to always return early
bugs.invariant: return self.overflow must be inside if self.overflow block, not if use_grad_scaling
bugs.detection_signal: FP16 训练时 optimizer step 后参数未正确更新；loss 不下降

bugs.title: Fix: Update grad norm calculation for CPU offload
bugs.root_cause: CPU offload 下 gradient clipping 后 norm_for_param_grads 数据结构未更新，导致记录的梯度范数与实际 clipped 梯度不一致，梯度裁剪效果失效
bugs.detection_method: CPU offload 时 gradient clipping 后记录的 grad_norm 与实际梯度值不匹配
bugs.detection_signal: CPU offload 时 gradient clipping 后记录的 grad_norm 与实际梯度值不匹配

bugs.title: Fix gradient accumulation for Z2+offload
bugs.root_cause: micro_step_id 初始化不一致（构造函数 0 vs backward -1），导致梯度复制/累积条件判断错误，非累积边界时也执行梯度复制而非累积
bugs.detection_method: ZeRO-2+offload 下梯度值在 micro step 边界处不连续；梯度范数模式与非 offload 不同
bugs.detection_signal: ZeRO-2+offload 下梯度值在 micro step 边界处不连续；梯度范数模式与非 offload 不同

bugs.title: Bug fix for the 'Link bit16 and fp32 parameters in partition'
bugs.root_cause: link_all_hp_params 使用全局 DP world_size 而非每个 param group 各自的 world_size，导致 MoE EP 场景下 partition size 计算错误，部分参数的 _hp_mapping 为 None
bugs.detection_method: MoE 参数的 _hp_mapping 为 None；保存 optimizer state 时崩溃
bugs.detection_signal: MoE 参数的 _hp_mapping 为 None；保存 optimizer state 时崩溃

bugs.title: Support bf16_optimizer moe expert parallel training and moe EP grad_scale/grad_norm fix
bugs.root_cause: bf16 optimizer 对 MoE EP 参数使用了错误的 DP group 进行 partition 和 allreduce，且梯度范数缩放因子差了 ep_size 倍
bugs.detection_method: MoE expert 参数在不同 EP group 间不正确同步；梯度范数与预期差 ep_size 倍
bugs.detection_signal: MoE expert 参数在不同 EP group 间不正确同步；梯度范数与预期差 ep_size 倍

bugs.title: Fix wrong idx bug in invertible LayerNormBackward1
bugs.root_cause: LayerNormBackward1 CUDA kernel 中 gamma/beta 数组访问时用了 pos (threadIdx.y) 而非 idx (threadIdx.x)，导致 gamma 梯度计算使用了错误的索引
bugs.detection_method: LayerNorm backward 的 gamma 梯度与参考实现 checksum 不同
bugs.detection_signal: LayerNorm backward 的 gamma 梯度与参考实现 checksum 不同

bugs.title: ZeRO3 uses default_stream instead of current_stream for gradient reduce
bugs.root_cause: reduce_and_partition_stream.wait_stream uses default_stream() instead of current_stream()
bugs.invariant: ZeRO3 reduce must wait on current_stream(), not default_stream()
bugs.detection_signal: ZeRO-3 训练中权重 partition 出现随机 NaN；不同 rank 和不同 layer 随机受影响

bugs.title: Fix sort of zero checkpoint files
bugs.root_cause: checkpoint 转换工具按字母顺序排序分片文件（10, 11, 9 而非 9, 10, 11），导致 optimizer state 碎片合并顺序错误，checkpoint 数据静默损坏
bugs.detection_method: universal checkpoint 转换后 optimizer state 的 checksum 与原始不匹配
bugs.detection_signal: universal checkpoint 转换后 optimizer state 的 checksum 与原始不匹配

bugs.title: Fix Adam subgroup inconsistency
bugs.root_cause: CPUAdam 的 IncrementStep 在同一逻辑 step 的多次 subgroup 调用中混合了乘法和重计算路径，产生非 bit-identical 的 bias-correction metadata
bugs.detection_method: 同一 step 不同 subgroup 的 Adam bias correction 值不一致
bugs.detection_signal: 同一 step 不同 subgroup 的 Adam bias correction 值不一致

bugs.title: Fix that ds_secondary_tensor may be dirty when loading the model or zero checkpoint for zero++
bugs.root_cause: GatheredParameters 退出后和 checkpoint 加载后 ds_secondary_tensor 未同步更新，后续 allgather 使用了过时的缓存数据，初始训练步 loss 异常偏高
bugs.detection_method: checkpoint resume 后初始 loss 异常高；ds_secondary_tensor 与 ds_tensor 的 checksum 不一致
bugs.detection_signal: checkpoint resume 后初始 loss 异常高；ds_secondary_tensor 与 ds_tensor 的 checksum 不一致

bugs.title: EP group created with num_experts instead of ep_size
bugs.root_cause: _create_ep_parallel_group(config.moe.moe_experts) should be (config.moe.ep_size)
bugs.invariant: EP parallel group size must use ep_size, not num_experts
bugs.detection_signal: EP group 数量为 0；MoE 推理结果与单卡不同

bugs.title: MoE gradient scaling divides by ipg_bucket_has_moe_params when it shouldn't
bugs.root_cause: divide=self.ipg_bucket_has_moe_params incorrectly divides MoE grads by bucket count
bugs.invariant: MoE gradient scaling must use divide=False
bugs.detection_signal: MoE expert 参数的梯度范数是预期值的 1/ep_size

bugs.title: Residual MoE softmax applied on wrong dimension
bugs.root_cause: softmax(coef, dim=1) should be dim=-1 for correct expert coefficient normalization
bugs.invariant: softmax dim must be -1 (expert dim), not hardcoded 1
bugs.detection_signal: Residual MoE 的 coef tensor softmax 后各维度和不为 1.0

bugs.title: Fix allreduce for BF16 and ZeRO0
bugs.root_cause: BF16_Optimizer 在 FP32 buffer 上累积梯度，但 engine 对 BF16 梯度执行 allreduce 而非 FP32 buffer，导致 reduce 的精度错误
bugs.detection_method: BF16+ZeRO0 下 allreduce 操作的 tensor dtype 与 optimizer 累积 buffer dtype 不匹配
bugs.detection_signal: BF16+ZeRO0 下 allreduce 操作的 tensor dtype 与 optimizer 累积 buffer dtype 不匹配

bugs.title: MoE CPU offload grad norm tensor stays on CPU instead of GPU
bugs.root_cause: scaled_norm_tensor not moved to GPU before norm computation with CUDA tensors
bugs.invariant: CPU-offloaded grad norm tensor must be moved to accelerator device
bugs.detection_signal: MoE CPU offload + DP > 1 时梯度范数与非 offload 参考值不同

bugs.title: Make z3 respect comm dtype
bugs.root_cause: ZeRO-3 忽略用户配置的通信 dtype，all-gather/reduce-scatter 使用错误的精度类型进行参数/梯度通信
bugs.detection_method: ZeRO-3 通信操作的 tensor dtype 与配置的 communication_data_type 不匹配
bugs.detection_signal: ZeRO-3 通信操作的 tensor dtype 与配置的 communication_data_type 不匹配

bugs.title: ZeRO Stage 2 seems to train MoE models incorrectly
bugs.root_cause: MoE gate 参数（deepspeed_moe.gate.wg）未被 ZeRO-2 的梯度 hook 捕获，gate 梯度从不参与 reduce，导致 gate 权重训练错误
bugs.detection_method: MoE gate 参数的 gradient 在 backward hook 中缺失；gate 参数不在 reduce_and_remove_grad_hooks 的 tracked 列表中
bugs.detection_signal: MoE gate 参数的 gradient 在 backward hook 中缺失；gate 参数不在 reduce_and_remove_grad_hooks 的 tracked 列表中

bugs.title: Fixed the problem of loading universal checkpoint error in multi-machine mode
bugs.root_cause: 多机环境下 stage3 universal checkpoint 加载逻辑存在 bug，导致加载后 loss 异常升高而非从断点恢复
bugs.detection_method: checkpoint resume 后 loss 异常升高而非从保存点继续
bugs.detection_signal: checkpoint resume 后 loss 异常升高而非从保存点继续

bugs.title: Fix checkpointing/loading of z0+bf16
bugs.root_cause: bf16+ZeRO0 时配置标志错误导致 optimizer 的 step counter、exp_avg、exp_avg_sq 等状态在 checkpoint 加载后丢失
bugs.detection_method: checkpoint resume 后 optimizer state 的 step counter 重置为 0；exp_avg/exp_avg_sq 为全零
bugs.detection_signal: checkpoint resume 后 optimizer state 的 step counter 重置为 0；exp_avg/exp_avg_sq 为全零

bugs.title: Fix the sequence-parallelism for the dense model architecture
bugs.root_cause: 序列并行下梯度被全局 world_size 错误缩放（应该是 SP rank 间求和后 DP group 内取平均），且 SP reduce 在 BF16 下执行导致精度损失，梯度范数持续增长
bugs.detection_method: SP=2 时梯度范数显著低于 SP=1；梯度范数随训练步数持续增长
bugs.detection_signal: SP=2 时梯度范数显著低于 SP=1；梯度范数随训练步数持续增长

bugs.title: ZeRO3: Gradient norm allreduce for DP
bugs.root_cause: ZeRO-3 的 gradient norm 在 DP 训练中未正确 allreduce，导致 ZeRO 0/1/2/3 产生不同的训练结果
bugs.detection_method: ZeRO-3 的 gradient norm 与 ZeRO-0/1/2 不一致
bugs.detection_signal: ZeRO-3 的 gradient norm 与 ZeRO-0/1/2 不一致

bugs.title: bf16_optimizer: fixes to different grad acc dtype
bugs.root_cause: bf16 optimizer 的 step 函数在 gradient accumulation dtype 与 model dtype 不同时未正确转换梯度到 FP32，导致数值不准确
bugs.detection_method: bf16 + FP32 grad_accum 时 optimizer step 中梯度 dtype 与预期不匹配
bugs.detection_signal: bf16 + FP32 grad_accum 时 optimizer step 中梯度 dtype 与预期不匹配

bugs.title: MOE gate fixes and enhancements
bugs.root_cause: 三个 bug：(1) gate capacity 未按 TP 对齐导致 token drop 时 crash；(2) gate 线性层在 forward 中被转成 fp32 但参数是 ZeRO flat buffer 的 view，破坏了参数管理；(3) top-2 aux loss 公式多乘了 num_experts
bugs.detection_method: gate 参数 dtype 在 forward 后被修改；top-2 aux loss 与 top-1 不成比例
bugs.detection_signal: gate 参数 dtype 在 forward 后被修改；top-2 aux loss 与 top-1 不成比例

bugs.title: Grad norm NaN handling uses wrong tensor operation (logical_or)
bugs.root_cause: inf_or_nan = norm_is_nan.logical_or(norm_is_inf) computes scalar-tensor op incorrectly
bugs.invariant: NaN/inf check must use Python or/and, not tensor logical_or on scalar results
bugs.detection_signal: grad_norm 为 inf 时 clipping 后梯度变为 NaN 而非保持 inf

bugs.title: reduce_bucket_size influences training convergence of Zero2
bugs.root_cause: reduce_bucket_size 本应仅影响通信效率，但实际影响了训练收敛：不同 bucket size 导致显著不同的 loss 曲线，极小值会导致 NaN
bugs.detection_method: 仅改变 reduce_bucket_size 即导致 loss 曲线显著变化
bugs.detection_signal: 仅改变 reduce_bucket_size 即导致 loss 曲线显著变化

bugs.title: Zero-sized microbatches for incomplete minibatches at DP boundary
bugs.root_cause: get_start_end_idx doesn't account for batch_len < dp_size * micro_batch_size
bugs.invariant: Microbatch slicing must handle incomplete last batch (batch_len parameter)
bugs.detection_signal: 部分 DP rank 的 microbatch 大小为 0；各 rank 的梯度平均权重不一致

bugs.title: Checkpoint global_step number inconsistent with checkpoint step number
bugs.root_cause: ZeRO-3 训练后期 checkpoint 目录名与内部 global_step 不一致（如 checkpoint-800 包含 global_step799），差距随训练扩大
bugs.detection_method: checkpoint 目录名中的 step 与内部 global_step 文件记录的值不匹配
bugs.detection_signal: checkpoint 目录名中的 step 与内部 global_step 文件记录的值不匹配

bugs.title: Fix all-gather duplicate params and wrong dtype
bugs.root_cause: PyTorch autocast 下同一 coalesced all-gather 中多个操作共享含混合 dtype 参数的列表，导致参数状态追踪错乱（expected AVAILABLE got inflight）
bugs.detection_method: ZeRO-3 参数状态 tracking 在 autocast 下出现不一致；all-gather 中参数 dtype 混合
bugs.detection_signal: ZeRO-3 参数状态 tracking 在 autocast 下出现不一致；all-gather 中参数 dtype 混合

bugs.title: Fix saving and loading model checkpoint logic for MiCS sharding
bugs.root_cause: MiCS 只有第一个 partition group 保存 checkpoint，其他 group 的数据丢失；加载时也缺少对 MiCS partition 的支持
bugs.detection_method: MiCS checkpoint 文件缺少非第一 partition group 的数据
bugs.detection_signal: MiCS checkpoint 文件缺少非第一 partition group 的数据

bugs.title: Fix the universal checkpoint issue for stage3 with multiple subgroups
bugs.root_cause: stage3 universal checkpoint 未正确处理多 subgroup 场景，tensor slicing 越界；多进程同时写入同一 checkpoint 文件导致竞争条件和数据损坏
bugs.detection_method: universal checkpoint 转换时 tensor 访问越界；多进程写入同一文件导致 checksum 不稳定
bugs.detection_signal: universal checkpoint 转换时 tensor 访问越界；多进程写入同一文件导致 checksum 不稳定

bugs.title: ZeRO Gradient Accumulation Dtype
bugs.root_cause: ZeRO 各 stage 强制梯度累积使用与模型权重相同的 dtype，BF16 训练时梯度在 BF16 精度下累积导致数值不稳定
bugs.detection_method: BF16 模型的 grad_accum buffer dtype 不是 FP32；梯度累积后精度损失可检测
bugs.detection_signal: BF16 模型的 grad_accum buffer dtype 不是 FP32；梯度累积后精度损失可检测

bugs.title: MOE: Fix save checkpoint when TP > 1
bugs.root_cause: MoE checkpoint 保存仅保留 rank 0 的 model_states 文件，TP > 1 时其他 TP rank 的数据缺失
bugs.detection_method: TP > 1 时 checkpoint 目录中仅有 mp_rank_00_model_states.pt，缺少其他 TP rank 文件
bugs.detection_signal: TP > 1 时 checkpoint 目录中仅有 mp_rank_00_model_states.pt，缺少其他 TP rank 文件

bugs.title: ZeRO-1/2 CPU-offload gradient norm underestimated with manual GA
bugs.root_cause: copy_grads_in_partition only accumulates when ga_steps > 1, misses micro_step_id > 0 case
bugs.invariant: CPU gradient buffer must be updated on every micro-step when cpu_offload is enabled

bugs.title: WarmupCosineLR multi-group initialization returns wrong-length LR list
bugs.root_cause: get_lr_ratio returns [0.0] list instead of 0.0 scalar; get_lr returns [0.0] instead of per-group list
bugs.invariant: LR scheduler get_lr() must return one value per optimizer param group

bugs.title: BF16 + ZeRO-0 gradients never zeroed between optimizer steps
bugs.root_cause: _take_model_step hits `pass` for bf16+zero_stage=0, skipping zero_grad entirely
bugs.invariant: Gradients must be zeroed after each optimizer step to prevent stale accumulation

bugs.title: ZeRO-3 reduce_and_partition_stream syncs against wrong CUDA stream
bugs.root_cause: __add_grad_to_ipg_bucket uses default_stream() instead of current_stream() for reduce_and_partition_stream synchronization
bugs.invariant: Stream synchronization must use current_stream() not default_stream() to prevent race conditions

bugs.title: Loss double-scaling in backward — scale_if_loss applied to gas_scaled_loss
ZeRO-1/2 CPU-offload gradient loss with multiple backward() per step
extra_large_param uses param.dtype instead of comm_dtype — gradient silently dropped
BF16_Optimizer incorrectly selected for bf16+fp32_grad_accum without ZeRO
ZeRO 1/2 elastic checkpoint optimizer state alignment ignores nccl_start_alignment_factor
bugs.root_cause: In _partition_base_optimizer_state, the alignment used for re-flattening merged optimizer state was just dist.get_world_size(group), but ZeRO pads optimizer states by nccl_start_alignment_factor * world_size when saving. As a result the per-rank optimizer state slices were misaligned and silently restored to the wrong parameters.
bugs.invariant: After load_checkpoint, optimizer.state[p] tensors must equal the pre-save optimizer.state[p] tensors element-wise for every parameter p.
trigger_conditions: load elastic checkpoint with different world size

bugs.title: ZeRO2 allreduce_bucket forces rank=None, never uses single-rank reduce path
bugs.root_cause: In refactor PR #4695, allreduce_bucket(self, bucket, rank=None, ...) was added with a hard `rank = None` reset at the very top of the function, which silently overrides any rank passed in by callers. The intended single-destination reduce path is therefore never taken and gradients always go through allreduce, producing different numerics on the receiving rank than expected.
bugs.invariant: When use_multi_rank_bucket_allreduce is False, dist.reduce should be called for gradient buckets while dist.all_reduce should not.

bugs.title: ZeRO3 contiguous_gradients off-by-one — last param exactly filling bucket is dropped
bugs.root_cause: The decision to copy a parameter's gradient into the contiguous IPG bucket used a strict less-than comparison (`elements_in_ipg_bucket + param.grad.numel() < reduce_bucket_size`). When a param exactly fills the remaining bucket capacity the branch was skipped, so the gradient was never copied into the contiguous buffer and never reduced — the parameter silently received a stale (or zero) gradient.
bugs.invariant: For every trainable param p with non-None grad after backward, the reduced gradient on the owning rank must be non-zero (or, when expected to be zero, must equal the locally computed grad).

bugs.title: load_module_only with bf16 silently skips refresh_fp32_params, optimizer trains on uninitialized fp32 weights
bugs.root_cause: Two bugs together: (1) load_zero_checkpoint required load_optimizer_states even when only loading the bf16 module, so it ran with no checkpoint files; (2) inside _load_checkpoint, the call to optimizer.refresh_fp32_params() was guarded by self.fp16_enabled(), so for bf16 the high-precision master weights were never refreshed from the loaded 16-bit module. Training proceeds with default-initialized fp32 master weights.
bugs.invariant: After load_checkpoint with load_module_only=True, optimizer.fp32_groups_flat[i] must equal bf16_groups_flat[i].float() for every group i.

bugs.title: ZeRO3 quantized_nontrainable_weights flag overwrites quantized_weights instead
bugs.root_cause: In zero.Init.__init__, when the deepspeed config has zero_quantized_nontrainable_weights=True but the local kwarg is False, the code mistakenly assigns the value to self.quantized_weights instead of self.quantized_nontrainable_weights — a copy-paste typo. Trainable weights end up being quantized while the nontrainable weights stay full precision (the opposite of what was requested).
bugs.invariant: After zero.Init, self.quantized_nontrainable_weights must equal config.zero_quantized_nontrainable_weights.
trigger_conditions: constructor caller did not pass zero_quantized_nontrainable_weights explicitly

bugs.title: ZeRO3 communication_data_type comparison inverted — buffer cast happens only when no cast is needed
bugs.root_cause: In __avg_scatter_contiguous_grads the gate was `if self.communication_data_type == self.dtype:` — exactly backward. When the user requested a different communication dtype, the buffer was NOT cast, so reduce-scatter ran on the wrong dtype; when it matched the model dtype the code wastefully cast to itself.
bugs.invariant: Inside __avg_scatter_contiguous_grads the tensor passed to reduce_scatter must have dtype == self.communication_data_type.
trigger_conditions: communication_data_type != model dtype (e.g. fp32 comm with bf16 model)

bugs.title: bf16+ZeRO1+CPU offload silently routes through bf16 wrapper; extra-large param uses raw param.grad instead of reduction grad
bugs.root_cause: Two related bugs: (a) The dtype dispatch picked the BFLOAT16 optimizer path for bf16+fp32-grad-accum even when CPU offload was on, where it doesn't work correctly. (b) For an extra-large param the reduction code took `self.extra_large_param_to_reduce.grad` directly instead of routing through get_gradient_for_reduction(), so when use_grad_accum_for_reduction was on the accumulated fp32 grad was bypassed and the raw bf16 grad was reduced (loss of precision and stale value).
bugs.invariant: When use_grad_accum_for_reduction is True, the tensor passed to average_tensor must be the same object/dtype as get_gradient_for_reduction(param), not param.grad.

bugs.title: ZeRO2 + MoE: fp32→fp16 master-weight copy uses outer-loop partition_id, writing into wrong rank's slice
bugs.root_cause: After optimizer.step(), the loop that copies fp32 master weights back to bf16/fp16 partitions used a single `partition_id` taken from the outer scope. With MoE, different param groups use different real_dp_process_group with different ranks, so the wrong partition slot in bit16_partitions was overwritten and the local rank's actual partition was never updated.
bugs.invariant: After optimizer.step, bit16_partitions[i][rank_i_in_group] must equal single_partition_of_fp32_groups[i].to(bit16_dtype) for every group i, where rank_i_in_group = dist.get_rank(group=real_dp_process_group[i]).
trigger_conditions: MoE model with expert parallel groups != data parallel group

bugs.title: Frozen parameters included in optimizer groups
bugs.invariant: Optimizer groups must only contain params with requires_grad=True

bugs.title: ZeRO2 + CPU offload: DeepSpeedCPUAdam fp32→fp16 partition_id is wrong across param groups
bugs.root_cause: When building bit16_param_groups for DeepSpeedCPUAdam.step(fp16_param_groups=...) and when copying fp32 partitions back to bit16 partitions, the code used a single outer-scope partition_id for all groups instead of computing the rank within each group's real_dp_process_group. With more than one group, every group except the first received the wrong rank's partition.
bugs.invariant: For each ZeRO param group i, the bit16 partition that was updated by DeepSpeedCPUAdam must be bit16_partitions[i][dist.get_rank(real_dp_process_group[i])].
trigger_conditions: multiple param groups using different real_dp_process_group

bugs.title: ZeRO2 round-robin gradient partitioning uses non-reordered group, mapping params to wrong partition owner
bugs.root_cause: The bookkeeping loop that builds param_to_partition_ids/is_partition_reduced iterated over self.fp16_groups (the original parameter order) even though gradient reduction itself uses self.round_robin_fp16_groups (the reordered list). The partition-owner table therefore disagreed with the actual reduction destination, so some params' gradients were attributed to the wrong owner and never appeared in the optimizer step.
bugs.invariant: param_to_partition_ids must be built from the same parameter ordering that average_tensor / reduce_scatter uses (round_robin_fp16_groups when round_robin_gradients is enabled).

bugs.title: Pipeline partition_balanced returns degenerate partitions, last PP stage can be assigned zero layers
bugs.root_cause: ds_utils.partition_balanced used a binary-search probe (_lprobe / _rb_partition_balanced) that, when probed with uniform weights, returned a non-monotone boundary list like [0,2,4,5,5] for 5 items / 4 parts — i.e. the last stage owns 0 layers. Pipeline modules construct from that boundary list and silently train with a stage holding no parameters.
bugs.invariant: For every adjacent pair (parts[p], parts[p+1]) returned by partition_balanced, parts[p+1] - parts[p] must be >= 1 (each PP stage owns at least one item).
trigger_conditions: uniform layer weights (e.g. partition by parameter count of identical layers)

bugs.title: MiCS save_non_zero_checkpoint True on every rank — checkpoint files race-overwrite each other
bugs.root_cause: self.save_non_zero_checkpoint = (rank == 0) or zero_optimization_partition_weights() became True for every MiCS rank because zero_optimization_partition_weights() is True under MiCS. All ranks then wrote the consolidated non-ZeRO checkpoint file, racing with each other and silently leaving inconsistent contents on disk.
bugs.invariant: For a MiCS run with shard_size S, exactly S ranks (those with global_rank < S) should report save_non_zero_checkpoint=True; all other ranks should report False.

bugs.title: ZeRO3 allgather hardcodes ds_tensor dtype — mixed-dtype param groups silently allgather wrong bytes
bugs.root_cause: all_gather_coalesced built one flat partition buffer assuming a single ds_tensor dtype across all params in the group, so when the param list contained mixed dtypes the larger-dtype params were silently truncated/aliased into the smaller-dtype buffer. After allgather, parameters held garbage bit patterns until the next iteration overwrote them.
bugs.invariant: After all_gather_coalesced, every gathered param p must satisfy p.data.dtype == p.ds_tensor.dtype and p.numel() * p.element_size() bytes were transferred for p.
trigger_conditions: model contains parameters of more than one floating dtype (e.g. fp32 LayerNorm + bf16 weights)

bugs.title: ZeRO3 InflightParamRegistry shared between train and eval coordinators causes stale handles on mode switch
bugs.root_cause: The training and eval PartitionedParameterCoordinators were both constructed with the same shared InflightParamRegistry. When the engine switched modes, in-flight allgather handles registered under one coordinator were observed by the other, which would either re-issue allgather on a still-inflight param or wait on a handle that was never going to fire — leading to silently-stale parameter values during the first iteration after the switch.
bugs.invariant: Each PartitionedParameterCoordinator must own a private InflightParamRegistry; the registry instance held by the train coordinator must not be the same Python object as the eval coordinator's.

bugs.title: ZeRO step uses post-decay loss_scale to unscale grad norm instead of prev_scale used during backward
bugs.root_cause: In DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer.step, _global_grad_norm was computed as scaled_global_grad_norm / self.loss_scale. But self.loss_scale is the *new* scale (already updated for this step), while the gradients that produced scaled_global_grad_norm were scaled by the *previous* scale (prev_scale). Dividing by the wrong scale silently skews the global grad norm used for clipping.
bugs.invariant: self._global_grad_norm * prev_scale must equal scaled_global_grad_norm for the step (i.e. unscaling uses the same factor that backward applied).
trigger_conditions: step where loss_scale was just halved due to overflow / scale-window

bugs.title: Sparse gradients silently not updating — SparseTensor wraps .data instead of param.grad
bugs.root_cause: In _get_gradients_for_reduction, the sparse-gradient branch wrapped `param.grad.data` into a SparseTensor: `grad_data = SparseTensor(grad_data)`. Because Python re-bound the local name and never wrote back into param.grad, the post-allreduce updated values were stored on a temporary SparseTensor that had no link to the parameter — the sparse embedding gradients were silently dropped.
bugs.invariant: After buffered_allreduce_fallback, param.grad of a sparse-gradient parameter must reflect the all-reduced values (non-zero where local grad was non-zero).

bugs.title: Pipeline parallel _aggregate_total_loss broadcasts torch.stack of mixed-dtype losses, non-last stages receive wrong dtype
bugs.root_cause: In _aggregate_total_loss the last stage built `losses = torch.stack([self.dp_group_loss, agg_loss])` and broadcast it to other PP stages. When the source tensors were bf16 the broadcast tensor was bf16 too, but other ranks initialised their receive buffer as fp32 (default Tensor()), so dist.broadcast wrote bf16 bytes into an fp32 tensor and other PP stages saw garbage scalar losses.
bugs.invariant: After dist.broadcast inside _aggregate_total_loss, the losses tensor must have the same dtype on every PP rank.

bugs.title: ZeRO param dtype cast inside zero_wrapper_for_fp_tensor_constructor reassigns Parameter to a non-Parameter Tensor
bugs.root_cause: zero_wrapper_for_fp_tensor_constructor cast tensors to the target dtype with `tensor = tensor.to(target_fp_dtype)`. For tensors that were already nn.Parameter (or had requires_grad=True), .to() returns a fresh non-Parameter Tensor without the autograd hook; the wrapper rebound the local name but the model still held the original reference, so the model's Parameter kept the wrong dtype and the (correctly-cast) shadow tensor became unreachable.
bugs.invariant: After zero.Init wraps a tensor constructor, the tensor visible to the model must satisfy `tensor.dtype == target_fp_dtype` and remain the same Python object that the model references.
trigger_conditions: model code constructs a tensor with requires_grad=True (e.g. via torch.empty(...).requires_grad_(True))

bugs.title: ZeRO3 builds fp16 partitions from full param_groups including frozen params, OOM-equivalent silent waste plus unused optimizer state
bugs.root_cause: DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer_Stage3._setup_for_real_optimizer called _create_fp16_partitions_with_defragmentation() on the raw self.optimizer.param_groups, including frozen params. Frozen params became part of the partitioned trainable list — they were placed into Adam fp32 state and received update increments from optimizer.step, silently un-freezing them.
bugs.invariant: Across optimizer steps, p.data must remain unchanged for every nn.Parameter with requires_grad=False.

bugs.title: ZeRO3 backward hook closure captures stale group index `i` — gradient routed to wrong reduction bucket
bugs.root_cause: create_reduce_and_remove_grad_hooks built the per-param backward hook via `wrapper(param, i)` where `i` was the loop index over groups. Because `i` was Python-late-bound inside the closure, every hook fired with the same final value of `i`, routing earlier groups' gradients into the last group's reduction bucket. The fix removes the unused `i` argument entirely (the bucket is determined from the param itself).
bugs.invariant: For every backward hook registered for parameter p in group i, the hook must call reduce_independent_p_g_buckets_and_remove_grads(p) without binding to a stale group index.

bugs.title: ZeRO optimizer.step() called once during initialization, increments Adam step counter before any real update
bugs.root_cause: All ZeRO/BF16 wrappers eagerly called the inner optimizer's step() during construction in order to materialize state tensors. This silently incremented the Adam state[`step`] counter for every param before any real backward pass, so the bias-correction terms were off by one (and beta1^t / beta2^t for the first few real steps were wrong) compared to vanilla PyTorch.
bugs.invariant: Right after deepspeed.initialize, optimizer.state[p]['step'] must equal 0 for every parameter p (no fake step has run).
